executive.narrative: In January 2026, UX decisions contributed an estimated $61,000 in cost value, helped ship 14 features on time, and established research coverage across 62% of design decisions — laying the foundation for a strong Q1.

topDecisions.title: Messaging Feature Survey (88% response rate) gave clear direction for improvement priorities
topDecisions.body: 21 of 24 panel members responded to the Messaging Feature Survey — identifying the most challenging features and focusing Q1 improvement efforts where they matter most.
topDecisions.outcome: Clear prioritization signal from 88% of panel membership

topDecisions.title: Feed Advisory Panel surfaced UX gaps before Q1 dev sprint kicked off
topDecisions.body: Panel session with 78 members across 55 banks identified friction points in the new Feed experience ahead of Q1 development. Adjustments were incorporated into design specs before engineering began.
topDecisions.outcome: Issues resolved in design, not in production

executive.narrative: In February 2026, UX decisions contributed an estimated $101,200 in cost value. The Feed Advisory Panel demo drove a 12% increase in new orders in 10 days — confirming that showing clients their feedback incorporated creates measurable business impact.

topDecisions.title: Feed Advisory Panel demo drove 12% increase in new orders in 10 days
topDecisions.body: Director of Product JoAnna Freeland and Director of Dev Joe Myers confirmed new Feed orders are up 12% in 10 days. The increase was attributed to the panel demo — clients seeing their feedback incorporated visibly changed purchasing behavior.
topDecisions.outcome: 12% increase in new Feed orders in 10 days

topDecisions.title: UBA Information Architecture V2 validated — 85.6% task success, up from 67.1%
topDecisions.body: The second round of UBA tree testing (n=10, screened panel) achieved 85.6% overall task success — an 18.5% improvement over V1. 4 participants achieved 100%. Labeling friction dropped significantly, confirming the domain structure was directionally correct.
topDecisions.outcome: +18.5% task success improvement over V1 baseline

executive.narrative: In March 2026, UX decisions contributed an estimated $212,500 in cost value — including a $150,000 POC kill that prevented a misdirected full build. Design sprint lead reached 71%, keeping engineering unblocked across all major product areas.

topDecisions.title: POC killed after validation testing — $150,000 in build cost avoided
topDecisions.body: A product concept in active prototyping failed validation testing against user expectations. UX research surfaced fundamental misalignment between the proposed direction and user mental models. The POC was killed before engineering began, avoiding an estimated $150K build.

topDecisions.title: Sprint lead at 71% — design ahead of engineering across most projects
topDecisions.body: Design ran ahead of engineering in 71% of active projects in March, ensuring dev teams had validated specs before sprint kickoff. This reduced mid-sprint design changes and prevented downstream rework across Feed, Messaging, and Jobs.
topDecisions.outcome: Engineering unblocked — rework risk down quarter-over-quarter

executive.narrative: In April 2026, UX decisions prevented an estimated $76,400 in avoidable spend, helped ship 18 validated features on time, and blocked two product directions that would have required significant rework in engineering.

topDecisions.title: Messaging abandoned a complex filter architecture after UXR showed users couldn't discover it
topDecisions.body: A planned multi-level filter system was killed in week 2 of April after usability testing with 6 participants showed 0% task completion. Engineering had budgeted 3 sprints. UX redirected to a progressive disclosure pattern that tested at 78% success in the same session.

topDecisions.title: Feed design review caught a data display error before dev handoff
topDecisions.body: During a design review of the Task Admin module, a UX designer identified that the proposed table layout would truncate critical account numbers on standard viewport widths. The fix took 2 hours in Figma. The equivalent engineering fix in production was estimated at 3 days.

topDecisions.title: Jobs onboarding flow redesigned based on journey mapping findings
topDecisions.body: A journey mapping session with 4 teller operators surfaced a consistent point of failure in cash balancing flows. The original flow required 7 steps for a task users expected to complete in 2. The redesigned flow reduced steps by 57% and reached stakeholder sign-off in the same sprint.
topDecisions.outcome: Flow complexity reduced 57%; stakeholder sign-off in-sprint

strategicContributions.title: Task Admin bulk actions
strategicContributions.problem: Operators had to action queue items one at a time, making large workloads slow and error-prone.
strategicContributions.evidence: 78% of tested users expected select-all behavior; task completion time averaged 4.2 min for batch work.
strategicContributions.recommendation: Introduce multi-select with a bulk action bar and clear selection state before building further queue features.
strategicContributions.outcome: Blocked downstream queue work until the interaction model is agreed; prototype validated with the ops panel.

strategicContributions.title: Search date-range filtering
strategicContributions.problem: Users could not filter account search results by date range, forcing manual scanning of long lists.
strategicContributions.evidence: Backend limitation surfaced during research; 6 of 8 participants abandoned the task.
strategicContributions.recommendation: Resolve the indexing constraint before shipping the redesigned filter panel.
strategicContributions.outcome: Flagged as a blocker to the search redesign; engineering scoping in progress.

strategicContributions.title: AI response confidence labels
strategicContributions.problem: Users could not judge how much to trust AI responses, reducing adoption of the assistant.
strategicContributions.evidence: Panel sessions showed hesitation and repeated manual verification of AI output.
strategicContributions.recommendation: Add confidence labels, reasoning surfaces, and fallback states to an already-shipping surface.
strategicContributions.outcome: Enhanced a live experience; trust and repeat usage improved in follow-up testing.

strategicContributions.title: Onboarding flow rework
strategicContributions.problem: Account creation had a high drop-off rate, limiting activation of new users.
strategicContributions.evidence: Funnel analysis showed a 34% drop at the verification step.
strategicContributions.recommendation: Rework the step sequencing and guidance on the current onboarding flow.
strategicContributions.outcome: Enhanced a high-traffic flow; drop-off reduced in the redesigned path.

strategicContributions.title: Quantifying UX dashboard
strategicContributions.problem: Leadership had no consistent way to see UX's contribution, so its impact stayed invisible in planning conversations.
strategicContributions.evidence: Monthly reviews relied on anecdotes; there was no shared view of research coverage, delivery, and influence.
strategicContributions.recommendation: Build a single dashboard that quantifies UX contribution across research, delivery, and business impact.
strategicContributions.outcome: Enhanced how leadership sees UX; contribution is now legible and tracked month over month.

strategicContributions.title: Making the design system AI-ready
strategicContributions.problem: AI-assisted design and vibe-coded prototypes drift from the system because the token layer alone carries values, not the reasoning behind them — so agents make logical-but-wrong choices.
strategicContributions.evidence: Components meant to be identical diverge across screens and sessions; agents can read a token's value but not when or why to use it, or how components relate.
strategicContributions.recommendation: Structure the system in three layers: a token layer (the raw values), an intent layer (what each token means and when to use it), and a guardrail layer (rules and design.md docs that constrain agent decisions).
strategicContributions.outcome: An early opportunity to make the system agent-ready, cutting AI-generated design debt and keeping output consistent across separate sessions.

strategicContributions.title: Prompt builder zero-state
strategicContributions.problem: New users faced an empty prompt builder with no guidance on where to start.
strategicContributions.evidence: Early concept testing surfaced confusion and low first-session success.
strategicContributions.recommendation: Explore zero-state patterns and example prompts as a new capability.
strategicContributions.outcome: A new opportunity to improve first-run experience; concept validated for further investment.

strategicContributions.title: Risk communication patterns
strategicContributions.problem: Users felt anxious interpreting risk information presented in technical language.
strategicContributions.evidence: Qualitative sessions surfaced repeated confusion and elevated task stress.
strategicContributions.recommendation: Prototype plain-language risk patterns as a new, unmet-need direction.
strategicContributions.outcome: An opportunity to reduce user anxiety; early patterns tested positively.

strategicContributions.title: Transact panel groupings
strategicContributions.problem: Dense transaction screens forced heavy scrolling, slowing operators during high-volume work.
strategicContributions.evidence: Session recordings showed repeated long scrolls to reach common panels; task time suffered.
strategicContributions.recommendation: Regroup transaction panels by frequency and task, collapsing rarely used sections to reduce scrolling.
strategicContributions.outcome: An optimization that cut scrolling and sped up common transaction tasks.

strategicContributions.title: Cross-product design tokens
strategicContributions.problem: Inconsistent spacing and color across products slowed delivery and review.
strategicContributions.evidence: Audit found 40+ divergent values for the same intent across teams.
strategicContributions.recommendation: Standardize a shared token set to simplify and speed up existing work.
strategicContributions.outcome: An optimization that reduced rework and sped up handoff across teams.

strategicContributions.title: Notification center consolidation
strategicContributions.problem: Notifications were spread across surfaces, adding noise and maintenance overhead.
strategicContributions.evidence: Support tickets cited duplicate and conflicting alerts.
strategicContributions.recommendation: Consolidate into one center to simplify the existing experience.
strategicContributions.outcome: An optimization that simplified the surface and reduced duplicate alerts.
